offering_description.value: Provides truckload, intermodal, dedicated fleet and brokered freight transportation and final-mile delivery across North America for shippers in retail, manufacturing and consumer goods. It moves customers' freight by combining its own trucks, containers and rail partners with contracted carriers, billed per shipment or under multi-year contracts.

primary_services.value: intermodal transportation; dedicated contract carriage; truckload freight; freight brokerage; final-mile delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: shippers and retailers in consumer goods, manufacturing, retail and food, and e-commerce companies

end_markets.value: retail; consumer goods; manufacturing; food and beverage; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for freight hauled by its trucks, containers and rail partners; project or contract: multi-year dedicated fleet and contract logistics agreements; commissions or management fees: margins on freight brokered to contracted third-party carriers
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: moves and delivers customers' freight, sold to shippers and retailers; asset operator: operates tractors, trailers, intermodal containers and terminals for its own services

geography_served.value: North America: United States across most states, plus Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: intermodal, dedicated contract, truckload, brokerage and final-mile services sharing shippers and technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national shippers and retailers; own locations: company terminals, offices and intermodal facilities; online: digital freight booking and tracking platform for customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: US DOT and FMCSA safety, hours-of-service, and emissions rules for trucking and rail-linked operations

notes: Segment mix and service lines may have changed; details reflect my general knowledge.
